set.body: Docs are already the most-aligned layer; this phase finishes them AFTER the code catches up, largely by driving the existing novelty epic bd-01M02MSCEDS68A4P4XFWHG0NPG to completion. Items owned here rather than there: (a) evidence ledger in novelty.md upgraded to the four labels (established algebraically / implemented / demonstrated / prospective) with every row linked to its machine-checkable artifact (test file, law helper, exemplar script, benchmark RDS); labels inside the 2x2 closure-table cells, mirrored in README; restore the Diedrichsen, Provost & Zareamoghaddam (2016) citation. (b) Gate 2 doc completion: show effect$signed beside the three energies in introduction.Rmd + README; energy-vs-signed caution; w-weighted orthogonality qualifier; optional Haxby 06 decomposition script. (c) Failure gallery doc consuming the Phase-1 classed refusals (existing bead bd-01M02MV82B1RAGQ65NKK1Q26H2; three verbatim refusals already in exemplars/haxby2001/results/smoke-report.md). (d) Retitle/split the evidence-pairing vignette cross-references (README:171-173, introduction.Rmd:270-272 promise a rectangular vignette; the file is a coupling/measurement vignette — relates bd-01KZY94REFFH9DQDJG7TD2J7XJ). (e) Verify novelty.html + correlation-distance-policy.html render in pkgdown; align mission.md/vision.md with the calculus framing; resolve the rMVPA shadow-install hazard noted in the Haxby exemplar README. Gates 1 (rsatoolbox fixture parity), 3 (real rectangular exemplar), 4 (conservation demo), 5 (query-first benchmark) remain tracked as children of the novelty epic; this bead closes when the ledger, gallery, and cross-references reflect completed gates.
set.title: Phase 4: Evidence and documentation — describe the repaired reality
